generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The added condition `!brokerConfig.isPopConsumerKVServiceEnable()` is repeated across multiple methods (`getConsumerLagStats`, `getInFlightMsgStats`, and `getAvailableMsgCount`). This repetition can lead to maintenance issues if the logic needs to change in the future. Consider extracting this check into a separate method or using a strategy pattern to handle different consumer types more cleanly.
